advancements.glow_sticks.crafting.craft_: Craft a glow stick by combining glowing items with glass.
advancements.glow_sticks.crafting.root.d: Get some light in the darkest areas of the world.
advancements.glow_sticks.interaction.pla: Place a glow stick, then sneak with a matching one to follow the waypoint particles.
advancements.glow_sticks.interaction.sha: It's dangerous in the dark! Share a glow stick with a player.
text.glow_sticks.creative_glow_stick.usa: Use to place. Click an existing glow stick to cycle its variant.
text.glow_sticks.creative_glow_stick.use: Perfect for creative building, this glow stick never fades away!
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_amber.descri: Warm like honey dripping from a beehive.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_aqua.descrip: Clear like the shallow water of a warm ocean.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_beige.descri: Pale like the sandstone of a desert temple.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_black.descri: Darker than a wither skeleton in the Nether.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_blue.descrip: Shines like lapis lazuli but without enchantments.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_brown.descri: Brown like dirt and just as decorative.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_coral.descri: Warm like a coral reef in a sunlit ocean.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_cyan.descrip: Deep blue like an ocean monument full of guardians.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_forest.descr: Deep green like the leaves of a dark oak forest.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_ginger.descr: Spicy orange like a fox in the taiga.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_gray.descrip: As dull as gravel in the rain.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_green.descri: Glows like a slime but does not hop away.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_indigo.descr: As dark as the void below the End islands.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_light_blue.d: Cold like ice drifting in a frozen ocean.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_light_gray.d: Almost invisible like a phantom during the day.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_lime.descrip: Glows green like a Creeper but without the explosion.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_magenta.desc: So flashy that even Endermen take a second look.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_maroon.descr: Dark red like dried redstone in an old mineshaft.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_mint.descrip: Fresh like the air on a windswept hilltop.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_navy.descrip: Deep like the ocean above a buried treasure.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_olive.descri: Muted green like moss on an ancient city wall.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_orange.descr: Shines like a torch but not forever.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_pink.descrip: As pink as a pig but much harder to eat.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_purple.descr: Mysterious like an End portal and much easier to carry.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_red.descript: Red like redstone but without the shock.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_rose.descrip: Blooms brighter than a rose bush in a flower forest.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_slate.descri: Cool and gray like deepslate far below.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_tan.descript: Earthy like a dirt path through a village.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_teal.descrip: Calm like a lush cave pool full of glow berries.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_verdant.desc: Green like a jungle canopy at high noon.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_white.descri: Glows brighter than a skeleton in sunlight.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick_yellow.descr: Shines like the sun but without the sunburn.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick.pickup: Sneak and use on a placed glow stick to pick it up again.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick.place: Use on a block to place the glow stick directly.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick.usage: Use to activate, then it will be thrown automatically.
text.glow_sticks.glow_stick.use_infinite: Placed glow sticks do not fade automatically.
